Case: Goal-based onboarding checklist is displayed with the chosen goal and channel after setup completion
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed all 6 steps of company setup at /en/register-company. Goal selected: "Set up shared Inbox". Channel selected: e.g., WhatsApp.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-008 · AC1]
  • Traceability: "After completing setup, user lands on a goal-based checklist (e.g. 'Set up shared Inbox' with 3 steps that include the chosen channel); banner 'Your 7-day Pro trial starts today'; 'Book a demo' link; help button."
Test Steps:
1. Complete company setup with goal "Set up shared Inbox" and channel "WhatsApp".
  2. Submit the final setup step ("Get started").
  3. Observe the landing page after setup.
  4. Verify the checklist content matches the selected goal.
Expected:
• A goal-based onboarding checklist is displayed.
  • Checklist heading or content references the chosen goal (e.g., "Set up shared Inbox").
  • Checklist steps include the chosen channel (e.g., WhatsApp).
  • At least 3 checklist steps are visible.
BDD: Given a user has completed setup with a specific goal and channel, When they land on the onboarding page, Then a goal-based checklist reflecting their selections is displayed

Case: User is assigned Admin role and 7-day Pro trial with 500 MAC is shown after setup
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed full signup flow and company setup. User is on the onboarding landing page or has navigated to profile/settings.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-008 · AC2]
  • Traceability: "Trial grants Pro features with 500 monthly active contacts, no credit card required; user is assigned company Admin role."
Test Steps:
1. Complete signup and company setup as a new user.
  2. Navigate to the profile menu or settings page.
  3. Check the displayed role.
  4. Check the trial plan details (Pro trial, 500 MAC).
Expected:
• User role is displayed as "Admin" (not Super Admin or other).
  • The subscription plan shows a 7-day Pro trial.
  • Monthly active contacts limit shows 500 MAC.
  • No credit card information is required or prompted.
BDD: Given a new user has completed signup and setup, When they check their profile or settings, Then their role is Admin and they have a 7-day Pro trial with 500 MAC

Case: Onboarding checklist steps reflect the channel selected in setup step 4
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed setup with a specific channel selection (e.g., Live Chat). User is on the onboarding landing page.
  • Source: [sleekflow-login-signup-008 · AC1]
  • Traceability: "goal-based checklist (e.g. 'Set up shared Inbox' with 3 steps that include the chosen channel)" — personalization based on step 4 channel.
Test Steps:
1. Complete company setup with a specific channel (e.g., "Live Chat widget").
  2. Observe the onboarding checklist on the landing page.
  3. Check that checklist steps reference or include the selected channel.
Expected:
• Checklist steps include references to the channel selected in setup step 4 (e.g., "Set up Live Chat widget").
  • The checklist is personalized — not a generic default checklist.
BDD: Given a user selected a specific channel in setup, When they view the onboarding checklist, Then the checklist steps include the chosen channel
